films.title: Köln 75
films.description: In 1975 Cologne, an ambitious teenage concert promoter , Vera Brandes (Mala Emde),defies her conservative family and navigates impossible odds to book American jazzpianist Keith Jarrett (John Magaro) for what becomes the legendary Köln Concert.

films.title: Enzo
films.description: A 16-year-old boy defies his bourgeois family's expectations by starting a masonry apprenticeship where he meets a charismatic Ukrainian colleague who shakes up his world.

films.title: Nino
films.description: One morning, Nino attends a doctor’s appointment where he is given some upsetting news. The treatment will start on Monday morning, but there is a high chance that it might leave him infertile, so the doctor tells him to consider freezing his sperm.

films.title: Boogie Nights (4K Restoration)
films.description: Paul Thomas Anderson's San Fernando Valley-set tale of the rise and fall of a dishwasher turned porn phenom is a bravura exploration of family, fame and the American dream in all its excess.

films.title: Leonora in the Morning Light
films.description: The story of artist Leonora Carrington, a womanwho turned trauma into transcendence, creatingbeauty from chaos and forging a legacy that changedthe history of modern art.

films.title: Familiar Touch
films.description: A coming-of-old-age film following an older woman’s transition into assisted living as she contends with her conflicting relationship with herself and her caregivers amidst her shifting memory, age identity, and desires.

films.title: Dry Leaf
films.description: An opaque journey through the Georgian countryside, Alexandre Koberidze's latest film is a remarkable exploration of absence, as a father traces a path through villages and football fields in search of his missing daughter.

films.title: Mare's Nest
films.description: A girl called Moon adventures in a world without adults inMare’s Nest, the latest feature by acclaimed British artist and filmmaker Ben Rivers.

films.title: Fuck The Polis
films.description: Fifteen years after the original trip to Greece, with a cancer diagnosis once thought final, a filmmaker retraces her journey through the Greek islands – this time with a group of young friends, filming, reading, singing, and moving from ferry to roadside to ruin.

films.title: The Misfits
films.description: A drama of broken-hearted cowboys and broken-down marriages, Clark Gable and Montgomery Clift co-star as an aging cowboy and a rodeo-rocked bull rider in John Huston’s swan song to the Western, and Marilyn Monroe’s final film.

films.title: Pink Narcissus 4k restoration
films.description: With its highly charged hallucinogenic quality and its atmosphere of lush decadence,Pink Narcissusis a landmark of gay cinema.

films.title: Tycoon
films.description: Charlotte Zhang's mesmerising debut feature effortlessly merges forms and formats to craft a paranoid spiral into a city on the brink, as Los Angeles is encircled by militarized policing, meat shortages and cockroach infestations on the eve of the 2028 Olympics.

films.title: Henry Henry Henry + The Queen of Versailles
films.description: A double-bill screening of Buck Ellison’s short film and Lauren Greenfield’s documentary.

films.title: Blue Heron
films.description: On Vancouver Island in the late 1990s eight-year-old Sasha and her Hungarian immigrant family attempt to build a new life, only to be destabilised by the increasingly dangerous behaviour of her older brother, Jeremy.

films.title: Audition (4K Restoration)
films.description: One of the most notorious J-Horror films ever made, Takashi Miike's Audition exploded onto the festival circuit at the turn of the 21st century to a chorus of awards and praise. The film catapulted Miike to the international scene and paved the way for such other genre delights asIchii the Killerand13 Assassins.

films.title: A Better Tomorrow (4K Restoration)
films.description: At once a landmark of 1980s Hong Kong cinema and the harbinger of John Woo's future star-studded career,A Better Tomorrowbroke the mould with its kinetic action sequences, razor sharp script and breakout performance by Chow Yun-Fat.

films.title: Literary Adaptation II: Charles-Ferdinand Ramuz
films.description: A programme exploring Godard’s relationship with Swiss author Charles-Ferdinand Ramuz. Includes the UK Premiere of the acclaimed restoration of Dimitri Kirsanoff’s landmark Ramuz adaptation,Rapt(The Kidnapping, 1934), and two Godard videos made in dialogue with Ramuz:Les Signes parmi nous(‘The signs among us’, 1998) and, co-directed with Anne-Marie Miéville,Liberté et patrie(‘Freedom and fatherland’, 2002).

films.title: Adieu Philippine
films.description: Capturing both the giddy thrill of innocent flirtation and the anguish of youth faced with an uncertain future, Jacques Rozier's debut feature was championed by his contemporaries François Truffaut and Jean-Luc Godard.

films.title: Birds of War
films.director: Janay Boulos and Abd Alkader Habak
films.description: A London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman retrace their love story over thirteen years of war, revolutions and exile. Drawing on intimate personal archive,Birds of Warasks what it means to build a life together in a world shaped by conflict.

films.title: As Aves
films.description: Inspired by Mia Couto's taleA Morte, o Tempo e o Velhoand Aristophanes' playThe Birds, this surreal fable delves into the relationship between humans, gods, and time, exploring the cycles of life and the quest for freedom.

films.title: Near Orouet
films.description: Perfectly capturing both the liberating promise and melancholic effervescence of summer,Near Orouëtis a masterpiece of the post-New Wave era and a beautiful meditation on the fleetingness of youth, love, and time.

tags: Time to Play Films by Jacques Rozier
Time to Play Films by Jacques Rozier

films.title: Komitas
films.description: Armenian Film Society London and Armenian Heritage Month campaign present the long overdue UK premiere ofKomitas, a haunting and unconventional film by Don Askarian centred upon one of Armenia’s most significant cultural figures, the pioneering composer and musicologist Komitas Vardapet.

films.title: Hunted: Kidnapped, blackmailed and tortured for being LGBTQ* + Panel
films.description: Abducted, beaten and tortured for money on camera, the footage then shared online, destroying lives. This is the world of “kito” attacks in Nigeria: where members of the LGBTQ+ community are entrapped, humiliated and extorted by gangs in a rising surge in violence and hatred.

films.title: Shorts Programme
films.description: This programme brings together four shorts by Jacques Rozier from 1958's Rivera-setBlue Jeansto 1983's unique reflection on the state of contemporary filmmakingLettre de la Sierra Morena

tags: Time to Play Films by Jacques Rozier
Time to Play Films by Jacques Rozier

films.title: The Last One for the Road
films.description: Francesco Sossai’s dazzling sophomore feature is many things at once: a road movie, a casual caper, a tribute to a vanishing industrial Italy, a scruffy intergenerational odyssey, and free-flowing bender through time and space.

films.title: Too Desi Too Queer
films.description: This now legendary LGBTQIA+ showcase is back with a fresh crop of inspiring, thought- provoking short films and Q&A discussions.

films.title: The Girls (4K Restoration)
films.description: Sumitra Peries' groundbreaking Sri Lankan film offers a tender and transporting journey through young dreams and first loves.

films.title: PRESSURE
films.description: PRESSURE explores the fetishism of bodies and the desire for no frills full body contact - stripped back to the sensation of flesh against flesh and the beautiful stink of sweat. Dust yourself off and get in the ring as we get physical with tickling, trampling, wrestling, and more than a few muscle mummies.

films.title: Anmol - Lovingly Ours + Q&A
films.description: A parent's love is put to the ultimate test when their newborn's unique identity forces them to confront their own beliefs and biases, leading to a heartwarming journey of acceptance and the true meaning of family.

films.title: All About Weddings
films.description: A dazzling Kolkata wedding spirals into a chaotic showdown over the course of a day, as secrets explode, relationships fracture, and unspoken desires come to the surface.

films.title: Master
films.description: Winner of the Big Screen Competition at IFFR, the film follows a socialist schoolteacher whose electoral victory in rural Bangladesh gives way to political compromise, exposing the corrosive machinery of power and bureaucracy.

films.title: The Castaways of Turtle Island
films.description: Having framed his first two features as seaside holiday films, Rozier used the third,The Castaways of Turtle Island,to mock the tourist industry in a hilarious comic send-up that could only have emerged from Rozier’s puckish imagination.

tags: Time to Play Films by Jacques Rozier

films.title: Give It a Shot + Q&A
films.description: A timely and inspiring documentary following the decades-long scientific push to bring a reversible male contraceptive to market, aiming to introduce the first breakthrough in reproductive technology since the modern condom, some 200 years ago.

films.title: Caronte
films.description: The River Douro in Porto is the area of Portuguese maritime territory with the highest number of suicides by jumping. Gastão has dedicated his life to recovering these bodies, not to try to save them, but to return them to their families, who can only move on once they have been recovered.

films.title: To the Horizon and Back + Q&A
films.description: Artist Alexander Carey-Morgan buries  himself within half a ton of clay for three days on a journey of self discovery and creative metamorphosis.
